scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -c cyan,magenta,yellow -n API,WEB,ADMIN "npm run dev -w @portfoygo/backend" "npm run dev -w @portfoygo/frontend" "npm run dev -w @portfoygo/admin"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently --kill-others -c cyan,magenta,yellow -n DB+API,WEB,ADMIN "npm run dev:local -w @portfoygo/backend" "npm run dev -w @portfoygo/frontend" "npm run dev -w @portfoygo/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portfoygo/frontend && npm run build -w @portfoygo/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @portfoygo/frontend && npm run lint -w @portfoygo/admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @portfoygo/frontend && npm run test -w @portfoygo/backend
